intro: When your sign goes dark, your property says the wrong thing about your business. Our licensed crew repairs and installs sign lighting, parking lot pole lights, and building lighting across South Florida, with our own bucket truck.

definition.heading: What our commercial lighting service covers
definition.body: Storefront and channel letter signs, parking lot and pole lights, exterior and security lighting, and interior lighting for offices, retail, and warehouses. We troubleshoot, repair, retrofit to LED, and install new.

symptoms.title: A sign that is dark, flickering, or half lit
symptoms.body: Drivers judge an unlit sign in one glance. We diagnose the letters, the power supplies, and the circuit feeding them.

symptoms.title: Parking lot lights that no longer come on
symptoms.body: A dark lot is a liability. Pole lights fail at the fixture, the photocell, or underground, and we check all three.

symptoms.title: Tenants or customers mentioning dark corners
symptoms.body: Dark entrances, walkways, and back corners push people away. Filling the gaps is usually simpler than a redesign.

symptoms.title: Lighting bills that keep climbing
symptoms.body: Old fixtures burn power and eat ballasts. We tell you where an LED retrofit pays for itself and where it does not.

localSections.heading: South Florida is hard on outdoor lighting
localSections.body: Heat, humidity, salt air, and storms corrode fixtures, connections, and photocells faster here than almost anywhere. We install with materials rated for this climate, so the fix holds through more than one season.

localSections.heading: Plazas, offices, and property managers
localSections.body: South Florida runs on strip plazas, offices, and managed properties, where lighting is a first impression that never sleeps. We handle one-time repairs and regular maintenance, and pull any permit in our own name.

guide.title: The honest guide to commercial lighting in South Florida

sections.heading: Sign lighting: what actually fails
sections.body: A dark channel letter is usually one of three things: the LED modules inside the letter, the power supplies feeding a section, or the circuit and time clock behind the wall. Swapping parts without finding the real fault is how a sign ends up half lit again in a month. We diagnose from the breaker to the letter face.

sections.heading: Parking lot and pole lights
sections.body: Photocells cloud over, fixtures fill with water, and the underground runs corrode at the connections. A lot that has gone half dark is rarely a coincidence, it is one shared fault working down a circuit. Our bucket truck reaches the heads, and our diagnosis reaches the wiring underneath.

sections.heading: LED retrofits, honestly
sections.body: For lighting that runs every night, a retrofit usually pays back twice: on the meter and on the maintenance you stop buying. It is not magic. Fixtures that rarely run, or poles needing structural work, may not pay back at all. We look at your run hours and tell you which retrofit earns its keep.

faqs.question: Can you repair a channel letter storefront sign?
faqs.answer: Yes. Letters, power supplies, wiring, and the circuit behind the wall, all from our own bucket truck. We recently brought a preschool's storefront sign from dark and damaged back to fully lit.

faqs.question: Do you handle parking lot pole lights?
faqs.answer: Yes. We service the heads from our own bucket truck and chase faults in the photocells, contactors, and underground wiring. A half-dark lot usually has one real cause, and finding it is what makes the repair last.

faqs.question: Can you put our property on a maintenance schedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plazas and managed properties do best with lighting checked on a rhythm rather than after complaints. We walk the property at night, keep the signs and lot at full strength, and flag problems early.

faqs.question: Do you do interior lighting for offices and warehouses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Office, retail, and warehouse lighting, from failed ballasts to full LED retrofits. We work around your business hours, including nights, and price the scope before we start.
